class.name: EditorExportDeviceAutorun
class.brief_description: Writes [code]autorun.inf[/code] beside Windows exports (including ZIP staging).
class.description: Options appear on export platforms whose OS name is [code]Windows[/code] (Windows Desktop, Windows Screensaver, and Windows Interactive DVD). The plugin writes [code]autorun.inf[/code] next to the staged binary during [code]_export_end[/code], so a later ZIP step includes it at archive root. CD/DVD media may still honor [code]OPEN=[/code]. USB flash drives on Windows 7 and later ignore [code]OPEN=[/code] and [code]ACTION=[/code]; [code]LABEL=[/code] and [code]ICON=[/code] still apply. This plugin does not change AutoRun policy.
